message.reasoning_content:
The error indicates that variables must be declared before any executable statements in the VAR block. In IEC ST, you can't declare variables in the middle of the code block. Let me fix this.

The issue is that I declared `enqueueRising` and `dequeueRising` inside a nested VAR block within the function block body, which is not valid IEC ST. All VAR declarations must come at the beginning of the function block.

Let me rewrite the code with all variables properly declared at the top.
